screenshots.name: wh-receiving-list
screenshots.description: Receiving page list view showing receipt records with status badges, tab switcher, and supplier/warehouse columns
screenshots.desiredState: Receiving page fully loaded with the List tab active. Table shows receipt rows with columns: receipt number, date, supplier, warehouse, total amount, and status badges (in-progress / completed). Tab bar at top shows List and Grouped views.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the receiving list tab with receipt rows in a flat table — not the grouped view, not the receipt creation modal

screenshots.name: wh-receipt-wizard
screenshots.description: Receipt creation modal showing header fields (date, receipt number, company, warehouse) and product line items entry row
screenshots.desiredState: Receipt creation modal/dialog is open on top of the receiving page. The modal shows header fields (date, receipt number, company dropdown, warehouse dropdown) and the line item entry section with columns for product code, name, unit, quantity, unit price, and totals.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the receipt creation form as a modal overlay — not the receiving list page behind it

stateSetup.description: Click the Create Receipt button in the page header to open the receipt creation modal

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (var b of btns) { if (b.querySelector('svg') && b.textContent.trim().length > 0) { var rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.top < 120) { b.click(); return 'clicked header button'; } } } var addBtn = document.querySelector('button[aria-label]'); if (addBtn) { addBtn.click(); return 'clicked add button'; } return 'no button found'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The create button selector may need adjustment based on actual DOM structure. Try clicking the prominent action button in the page header area.

mustNotShow: Only the list page without modal

screenshots.name: wh-transfers-list
screenshots.description: Transfers page showing grouped view with transfer records, status badges, and tab bar including Pending Approval tab with orange count badge
screenshots.desiredState: Transfers page fully loaded. Tab bar shows All Transfers, Grouped View, and Pending Approval tabs. The Pending Approval tab has an orange badge with the count of pending items. Table displays transfer records with columns: document number, date, source/destination departments, status.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the transfers list page with the tab bar visible (especially the Pending Approval tab with badge) — not the transfer creation modal

mustShow: Transfer table rows or empty state

screenshots.name: wh-transfer-create
screenshots.description: Transfer creation modal (Transfer Book) with source/destination department selectors and dual-panel item picker for selecting inventory items
screenshots.desiredState: Transfer Book modal is open showing the dual-panel interface. Header has date, document number, From Department dropdown, To Department dropdown, and Direct Write-Off toggle. Left panel shows available items from source department. Right panel shows selected items for transfer.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Transfer Book modal with dual panels — not the transfers list page, not the approval tab

stateSetup.description: Navigate to transfers page and click the New Transfer button to open the Transfer Book modal

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (var b of btns) { var rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.top < 120 && b.textContent.trim().length > 0 && rect.width > 80) { b.click(); return 'clicked header action button'; } } return 'no button found'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The New Transfer button selector may need adjustment based on actual DOM structure. Look for a prominent action button in the page header.

mustShow: Dual panel layout or item picker area
mustNotShow: Only the list page without modal

screenshots.name: wh-transfer-approval
screenshots.description: Pending Approval tab on the Transfers page showing transfers awaiting confirmation with confirm and delete action buttons
screenshots.desiredState: Transfers page with the Pending Approval tab active. The tab shows a list of transfers that need confirmation from the receiving department. Each row has transfer details (document number, items, source/destination) and action buttons (confirm, delete).
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Pending Approval tab content — not the All Transfers or Grouped View tabs, not the Transfer Book modal

stateSetup.description: Navigate to transfers page and click the Pending Approval tab

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'); for (var t of tabs) { var badge = t.querySelector('[class*="badge"], [class*="Badge"], span[style]'); if (badge || tabs.length >= 3) { if (t === tabs[tabs.length - 1]) { t.click(); return 'clicked last tab (pending approval)'; } } } if (tabs.length >= 3) { tabs[2].click(); return 'clicked third tab'; } return 'tabs not found, count: ' + tabs.length; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The Pending Approval tab may be the 3rd tab. If no pending transfers exist, an empty state will be shown. The orange badge count depends on live data.

mustShow: Transfer rows with action buttons or empty state

screenshots.desiredState: Inventory page loaded with the Stock Levels tab active. Table shows stock items with columns: code, goods name, type, quantity, price, total, unit, expiration (with color-coded badges), and series/lot. Filter panel visible with department dropdown and filter options.

screenshots.name: wh-inventory-picking
screenshots.description: FEFO picking queue tab showing approved transfer request cards and pick list table with lot-level suggestions sorted by expiration date
screenshots.desiredState: Inventory page with the Picking Queue tab active. Left side shows transfer request cards (each with item name, source/destination departments, quantity needed). Right side or below shows the pick list table with lot-level rows sorted by expiration (FEFO), including columns: product code/name, bin location, lot number, expiration date, quantity requested, suggested pick, confirmed pick.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the FEFO picking queue tab — not the stock balances tab, not any modal

stateSetup.description: Navigate to inventory page and click the Picking Queue tab

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'); for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) { if (i >= 1) { tabs[i].click(); return 'clicked tab index ' + i; } } return 'tabs not found, count: ' + tabs.length; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The Picking Queue tab position may vary. If no approved transfers exist, the queue will show an empty state. FEFO lot suggestions depend on actual inventory data.
